blocks.tamil_translation: me, behind me, on my right, on my left, above me and below me, create light! (Make every side full of light.) Create light in my hearing, in my sight, in my hair, in my skin, in my flesh, in my blood and in my bones! O Allah! Increase my light, grant me light! Create light for me! Pure is that Allah who has taken honour as His cloak; and His word is honourable. Distinction and honour are His garment; pure is Allah who has bestowed distinction and honour. To be declared pure of all defects belongs to the pure Allah alone. Pure is Allah, the Possessor of bounty and favour; pure is Allah, the Possessor of distinction and generosity; pure is Allah, the Possessor of majesty and honour.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ صَلَّي فِي لَيْلَةٍ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ، وَمَنْ صَلَّي فِي لَيْلَةٍ بِمِائَتَيْ آيَةٍ فَإِنَّهُ يُكْتَبُ مِنَ الْقَانِتِينَ الْمُخْلِصِينَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال:صحيح علي شرط مسلم ووافقه الذهبي:١ /٣٠٩
blocks.tamil_translation: “Whoever, on any night, recites a hundred ayahs in Salah will not be counted that night among the heedless (who forget the worship of Allah). Whoever, on any night, recites two hundred ayahs in Salah will be counted that night among the righteous slaves who worshipped with sincerity.” Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ﵄ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: مَنْ قَامَ بِعَشْرِ آيَاتٍ لَمْ يُكْتَبْ مِنَ الْغَافِلِينَ، وَمَنْ قَامَ بِمِائَةِ آيَةٍ
